scenario_sampling.method: NumPy default_rng(seed).choice(sorted eligible IDs, count, replace=False)

protocol.primary_recovery: Existing Eastward sideways maneuver only; no climb selection
protocol.forecast_timing: Original StaleGuard pair shares one command forecast/runtime; each new policy independently computes/times the three-profile forecast
protocol.readiness: Full measured warmed computation, rounded to first available 50 Hz step; unavailable forecasts fail open
protocol.ordering: Approval; readiness; actual dispatch; pending timers; maneuver initiation; physical ticks
protocol.beyond_prediction_horizon: No predicted expiration permits dispatch beyond 1 s; finite ready expiry rejects; no new horizon cutoff
protocol.unknown_delay: Only the simulator schedules future dispatch; the policy observes it when it occurs

dual_horizon_decision_rule: completion uses remaining feasible sampled intervals while pending and the most recent sample at dispatch
